== Summary ==
[[Charlie Arlandson]] wearing his earlier Team Tournament Winner medals on the morning of the [[2018 Minnesota State Team Tournament]], posted in the event thread: "Sup y'all it's ya boy chicken little." His team, Team Rosemount, won that day. The face matches [[:File:Charlie Arlandson 2022 U.S. National Championship Team Rosemount.jpg]].

* '''Event:''' [[2018 Minnesota State Team Tournament]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2018-04-07
* '''People:''' [[Charlie Arlandson]]
